metadata.title: That 1 kill where Valorant paused to question my sanity
metadata.description:
Wait, did that just happen? Enemy probably AFK or just confused.
Valorant logic handing me a kill like it’s a glitch in the matrix.
Click if your aim’s mostly ‘how did I even click that?’

Tap if your kills are more ‘oops’ than ‘pro’!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
